answer: The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in glacier, expire in nadir, and willow lists each expiry. Someone running 103 aliases thus needs 52 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4317 identities would post 2704 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
